title: Fantastic
text: Maria did an excellent job.  She was knowledgeable and comprehensive. The tour was just long enough and very informative.
author: 172tamelaf

title: Tour of the Picasso Museum
text: This was not only an exceptional tour, but also a wonderful education in Picasso’ life and insight into his art! Maria was a wonderful tour guide. She was extremely knowledgeable about Picasso. My friends and family enjoyed this very much and highly recommend Maria for this tour!
author: Steve_C

title: Maria was very...
text: Maria was very knowledgeable and a terrific and patient guide.  Highly recommend her.  I am not sure which company she works with as Viator is an aggregator
author: Rina_B

title: Picasso Museum Private Tour
text: We had a private tour with Maria as our guide. Thoroughly enjoyed learning about Picasso from Maria as she was very knowledgeable about the artist and his family. Maria was also very personable and encouraged questions. I would recommend this tour with Maria for those who want an in depth presentation  on Picasso.
author: James_K

title: Wonderful Experience
text: Maria was a wonderful guide adding so much to my museum experience. I learnt so much about Picasso and his life. I can highly recommend this tour!
author: Linda_H

title: Picasso
text: Maria was very pleasant and knowlegable on the subject. I would recommend the tour to friends and family.
author: Anthony_D

title: An exceptional experience
text: The few hours that I spent with Maria in the Picasso Museum was exceptional. I enjoyed every second of it and appreciated her time and knowledge about the artist and the district.
author: erentiat

title: Recommend Picasso and El Born Tour!
text: My family really enjoyed the tour of the Picasso Museum and walk in El Born district and my two teenage daughters are hard to please. We found it fascinating to see how Picasso's work evolved from the classic style to his signature Cubist style for which he is known for.  I don't think this would be possible without Maria's explanation.  I would highly recommend Maria.  Thanks!
author: cindychen37

title: Excellent intro to Picasso
text: Maria was a wonderful guide to help introduce us to the world of Picasso.  We have limited art knowledge, so the pace was good for those looking to experience the museum and get a better understanding of the artist.
author: Travis_S
